data.name: Bad Inmate
data.detailed_description:
Every escape attempt is a new chance to do something smarter, funnier, or way more questionable.

Grab a spoon and start digging. Use a dumbbell like it was definitely part of the plan. Steal a key, unlock a cell, trick a guard, scan another prisoner’s face, or throw lunch at someone who probably deserved it.

This is a physics-driven VR sandbox where almost everything can be picked up, used, tossed, hidden, or turned into part of your escape plan. Explore the prison, find strange items, complete weird favors for your mysterious wall buddy, and discover all the ways your “perfect plan” can fall apart.

Maybe you sneak out like a genius. Maybe you start a prison-wide mess. Maybe a security camera spots you and sends you right back to your cell.

No big deal. Try again. Make a new plan. Make a worse plan. See what happens.

Escape, prank, fight, throw, crawl, and improvise your way through the dumbest prison break VR has ever seen.

data.short_description: You’re stuck in prison… and the guy in the wall says he can help. Bad news: his plans are weird. Sneak past guards, grab random stuff, prank inmates, throw food, steal keys, crawl through holes, and try to escape in the most ridiculous VR prison sandbox ever.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 equivalent or greater
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 290 or greater
  • VR Support: Steam Frame, Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3, Meta Quest 3S, HTC Vive, Valve Index
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection required
